name: Question 1
problem:
Consider the set of matrices ${A,B},$ where 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 \\ -1 & 10\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}-4 & 6 \\ 2 & -12\end{aligned}].
$$

If the set is linearly dependent, find the value of $\frac{{x}_{1}}{{x}_{2}}$ from a non-zero solution of ${x}_{1}A+{x}_{2}B=O,$ where $O$ is the $2\times 2$ zero-matrix.
worked_solution:
If the set is linearly dependent, then there exist ${x}_{1},{x}_{2}$ not both zero such that 

$$
{x}_{1}A+{x}_{2}B=O.
$$

Otherwise, if ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}=0,$ the set is linearly independent.

Substituting the matrices $A$ and $B$ into the above equation, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 \\ -1 & 10\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-4 & 6 \\ 2 & -12\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1} & 5{x}_{1} \\ -{x}_{1} & 10{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-4{x}_{2} & 6{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{2} & -12{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}-4{x}_{2} & 5{x}_{1}+6{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} & 10{x}_{1}-12{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding entries, we obtain the following system of equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}-4{x}_{2}=0 \\ 5{x}_{1}+6{x}_{2}=0 \\ -{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=0 \\ 10{x}_{1}-12{x}_{2}=0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we consider the corresponding augmented matrix and reduce it to row echelon form using Gaussian elimination:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 & 0 \\ 5 & 6 & 0 \\ -1 & 2 & 0 \\ 10 & -12 & 0\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}/2\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 5 & 6 & 0 \\ -1 & 2 & 0 \\ 10 & -12 & 0\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-5){R}_{1} \\ {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+{R}_{1} \\ {R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+(-10){R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 16 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 8 & 0\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+(-\frac{1}{2}){R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 16 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The pivot columns are the $1$st and $2$nd columns. Therefore, we get the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}-4{x}_{2}=0 \\ 16{x}_{2}=0,\end{aligned}
$$

which has only the zero solution ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}=0.$

Consequently, ${A,B}$ is linearly independent.
